messages:
Anika (AE): Quick sync — Cypress AI POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Need success criteria, security status, pricing options. Who's free?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Im in. I'll bring eval plan + prompt templates. Jordan, will they provide S3 access or upload?

Jordan (Customer Eng): S3 read-only will be provided. Two flows: intent classifier (latency-sensitive) and context-heavy assistant (20k docs).

Ravi (Sales Eng): Procurement asked for a token-cost estimate for a 2-week POC and a short reserved quote. Can engineering give a rough range?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Ballpark hosted PAYG $150$400 for two weeks depending on batching; dedicated helps latency but needs 72h lead. Recommend a 1k-request smoke test to baseline p50/p95.

Priya (Security): They require completion of vendor questionnaire before we issue keys and EU data residency. Uploaded link: https://files.example.com/cypress-security-q3. I'll draft answers but need KMS doc link.

Anika (AE): Proposed success criteria: classifier >=88% F1; assistant median latency <300ms single-turn; no PII in 50-sample audit. Agreed?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Agree. I'll drop scrub script and audit checklist into kickoff folder.

Ravi (Sales Eng): I'll prepare pricing slide with hosted vs short reserved. Jordan, please confirm legal contact for the POC clause.

onboarding-bot: Reminder created: "Cypress POC - Vendor Intake" assigned to Priya, due in 3 days.

Anika (AE): Action items: Tom uploads artifacts; Priya completes vendor form draft; Ravi readies pricing; Jordan shares S3 path. I'll send invite. :thumbsup:
